quotes.text: Enterprise AI isn't about the model, it's about the perimeter. The perimeter is the structural boundary that keeps your data safe, your costs visible, and your reasoning auditable.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the central thesis of the episode in one sentence.

quotes.text: This assumption is broken for AI in a way it never was for traditional infrastructure, security debt compounds faster with AI than any other workload type.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why the secure-it-later approach fails for AI workloads.

quotes.text: Managed identities are the only way to eliminate secrets from your infrastructure. Not reduce them, not hide them better. Eliminate them because once a secret exists in a configuration file in environment variable or a connection string, it exists.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A strong, practical argument for identity-based authentication.

quotes.text: Cost attribution is only possible if your infrastructure is designed for it from day one. You can't retrofit attribution onto a system that wasn't designed for it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Links FinOps for AI directly to infrastructure design decisions.

quotes.text: Catching a mistake during CI is a 30 second fix, catching a mistake after its deployed to production is a three hour incident. Preventing the mistake entirely is better than both.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable case for validating infrastructure in pipelines.

takeaways: Manually deployed AI infrastructure leads to configuration drift, invisible token costs and audit failures, so the perimeter must be built in code from day one.
A hardened AI perimeter combines managed identities, private endpoints, Azure Policy with management groups, token-level observability and orchestration through Azure AI Foundry and API Management.
Reusable Bicep modules validated in CI/CD pipelines turn governance, cost attribution and security into defaults instead of afterthoughts.
hook: Deploying Azure OpenAI in the portal works for a proof of concept, but it turns into audit failures, data exposure and untraceable token costs at scale. This masterclass shows cloud architects and platform teams how to build a hardened AI landing zone with Bicep, from identity and network isolation to policy, FinOps and API Management.
